title: Rainfall-Runoff Lag and Stability across Seven Poyang Lake Basins
description: Reproducible software, processed data, analysis outputs, and figures supporting the study of rainfall-runoff correlation lag, seasonal differences, and stability across seven sub-basins of the Poyang Lake Basin. The data coverage period is 2006-2020, the main analysis period is 2006-2019, and 2020 is used only in sensitivity scenarios. Analysis code is licensed under the MIT License; processed data, result tables, and figures are licensed under CC BY 4.0. The upstream Mendeley Data Excel files are not redistributed.
